# BFA Coworker Wiki Documentation — Agent Skill

## Overview

This skill covers the **bfa_coworker wiki documentation system** — a Python script
(`_misc/generate_wiki.py`) that scans the addon source code and auto-generates
22+ GitHub Wiki markdown pages with screenshot placeholders.

```
Source Code (addon/ + mcp/)
    │
    ├── AST Parser → Operators, Preferences, MCP Tools
    ├── Manifest Parser → Version, Metadata
    ├── Module Indexer → File Tree, Docstrings
    │
    └── generate_wiki.py
            │
            └── bfa_coworker.wiki/
                    ├── Home.md
                    ├── _Sidebar.md
                    ├── _Footer.md
                    ├── Quick-Start.md
                    ├── User-Documentation/ (7 pages)
                    ├── Developer-Documentation/ (8 pages)
                    └── API-Glossary/ (4 pages)
```

## Prerequisites

- The `bfa_coworker` workspace with addon source code.
- Python 3.10+ (stdlib only — no external dependencies).
- The `bfa_coworker.wiki` repo cloned alongside the main repo.

## Wiki Structure

### Top-Level Pages
- **Home.md** — Landing page with feature grid, architecture diagram (Mermaid), quick links
- **_Sidebar.md** — Full navigation tree mirroring the 5 sections
- **_Footer.md** — License, repo link, contribution link
- **Quick-Start.md** — 3-step flow: Install → Configure → Chat

### User Documentation (7 pages)
- `Installation.md` — Download .zip, install in Blender, enable, first launch
- `Configuration.md` — All 4 preference tabs explained with property tables
- `Chat-Interface.md` — Panel layout, Agent vs Ask mode, @mentions, project rules
- `Local-LLM-Setup.md` — Model presets, download flow, llama-server, scanning
- `Remote-API-Setup.md` — OpenRouter, BYOK providers, saved profiles
- `Generative-AI.md` — Backend selection, Poly Haven, plugin types
- `Troubleshooting.md` — Port conflicts, download issues, common errors, logs

### Developer Documentation (8 pages)
- `Architecture.md` — 3-component diagram, data flow, TCP bridge protocol
- `Addon-Structure.md` — File tree, module responsibilities, registration order
- `MCP-Server.md` — FastMCP setup, transport modes, tool auto-discovery
- `MCP-Tools.md` — All 24 tools with descriptions, parameters, use cases
- `Plugin-System.md` — GenPlugin base class, plugin types, auto-discovery
- `Skills-System.md` — Version-aware .md loading, skill file format
- `Building-and-Testing.md` — build_addon.py, Makefile targets, test suites
- `Contributing.md` — Code style, PR process, upstream sync

### API / Glossary (4 pages)
- `Operators-Reference.md` — Auto-generated table of 29 operator classes
- `Preferences-Reference.md` — Auto-generated table of 50+ properties by tab
- `MCP-Tools-Reference.md` — Auto-generated table of 24 MCP tools
- `Glossary.md` — Key terms: MCP, Bridge, LLM, GGUF, llama-server, etc.

## Screenshot Placeholder Format

Every major UI section gets a screenshot placeholder:

```markdown
> 📸 **SCREENSHOT NEEDED:** [What to capture]
>
> - **Where:** [Location in Blender — e.g. Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Coworker]
> - **State:** [What Blender should look like — e.g. "Local LLM tab selected, model downloaded"]
> - **Callouts:** [What to annotate — e.g. "1. Operating Mode selector, 2. Model Preset dropdown, 3. Download button"]
```

## Regeneration Workflow

1. Make code changes to the addon
2. Run: `python _misc/generate_wiki.py --output-dir ../bfa_coworker.wiki`
3. Or: `make wiki`
4. Review changes in the wiki folder
5. Commit and push the wiki repo

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `_misc/generate_wiki.py` | Main generator script |
| `bfa_coworker.wiki/PLAN.md` | Implementation plan |
| `bfa_coworker.wiki/CHANGELOG.md` | Wiki changelog |
| `Makefile` | `wiki` target |

## Conventions

- All generated pages have `<!-- GENERATED by _misc/generate_wiki.py -->` at the top
- Internal links use `[[Page-Name]]` or `[[Folder/Page-Name]]` GitHub Wiki syntax
- Tables use standard GitHub markdown pipe syntax
- Mermaid diagrams for architecture/flow visualizations
- Screenshot placeholders use `> 📸` blockquote format
